The '''Mongrel Altar''' was an altar constructed within a natural depression which held the [[Eternal Pyre]] and was located just east of the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].

==Overview==
Constructed near to the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] by the [[Sith Empire (Pre-Republic)|Sith Empire]], the Mongrel Altar was located in a natural depression which housed the [[Eternal Pyre]]. Following the arrival of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exiles]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Sorzus Syn]] led an expedition across the planet to sites of interest to learn what she could of [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith culture]]. At the pyre she discovered the Altar concealed behind a mural of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Adas]]; within the altar was hidden a set of cursed scrolls and the headless corpse of [[Wyrmuk the Undying]]. The scrolls, kept within a pool of bloody slurry, contained many [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith sorcery/Legends|spells]] and enchantments.<ref name="BOS" />
